Excellent service and lots of love for the pets! I've been taking my Pennyzinha to Nosso Pet for a while now and I'm always very well received. The staff is attentive, the products are high quality, and you can see that they really care about the animals. I recommend them without hesitation!

I loved it.
Zoe loves being cared for by them, great service.

The service was wonderful, my pet came back absolutely amazing, smelling great, and most importantly, he loves the lady who takes care of him with love and empathy. I told her that he suffered a trauma at the end of last year, underwent surgery because he lost sight in his right eye during the attack, that I didn't want him near other pets at all, and that he was even more scared during bath time. Well, my baby comes back super happy, inseparable from his aunt, haha, and when he gets home he plays, eats, and rests so peacefully because he was loved and cared for by his aunt.

Auntie, lots of kisses, I love you Nick!
Great. The staff takes great care of the pets.

I love it every time Pirulito goes for a bath; he comes back smelling so good, and the best part is that he loves it, despite his grumpy face.

Fred has been getting baths and grooming from Tiago since he was a puppy. I believe he won't accept anyone else because of the affection and attention he receives. I can only be grateful for that. In this photo, he was about 8 months old, his first bath with you guys.

Best pet groomer in the region! My baby is big and has short fur, so she sheds a lot, and when she goes for a bath at the groomer, she comes back impeccable, with soft, hydrated fur and much less shedding. It's the only groomer I don't worry about leaving my daughter at; I know they'll take care of her as if she were their own.

Reliable and well-structured environment.

They are simply amazing! Baths are done with quality products that last a long time (in other places we've been, my bulldog's bath only lasted 2 or 3 days). He comes back perfectly groomed, they trim very well, and the service is always excellent. Call them without hesitation.
